method: GitHub code search (gh api search/code) over public repositories, raw files fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com, run through agent_files.instruction_shapes.find_instruction_hits. Contents not committed. Only files named exactly AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md or .cursorrules are counted (1,804 files, 1,785 repositories).

ordinary_sample.description: Not selected on the matcher's terms: filename:AGENTS.md and filename:CLAUDE.md (size 500..3000 and 3000..10000), filename:GEMINI.md, filename:.cursorrules; top search results (up to 3 pages of 100 per query).

targeted_sample.description: Selected to contain the matcher's words: AGENTS.md with 'config.toml'; CLAUDE.md with 'settings.json'; AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md with 'dangerously-skip-permissions'; AGENTS.md with 'BASE_URL'; CLAUDE.md with 'ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL'.

first_version.note: Before the config-edit rule required an opening imperative verb, a machine-wide path and an MCP/hook/approval payload, it fired on 28 of 592 targeted config/settings files. 22 were read: all described what a tool or installer writes, or told a user how to set up a tool; none was an instruction to the agent. The frozen rule fires on 0 of them. Partly in-sample for that reason.

recall: No real planted file is public. Recall was checked only on sentences written for this project (tests/test_agent_files_dropped.py).
